## Third party schemas

This folder contains schemas defined by third parties specifications used by OPF. The original schemas might have been adapted to reflect stricter requirements of OPF.

| name | specification | description |
|------|---------------|-------------|
|[KHR_texture_basisu](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF/tree/main/extensions/2.0/Khronos/KHR_texture_basisu) | [glTF 2.0](https://registry.khronos.org/glTF/specs/2.0/glTF-2.0.html) | Official glTF extension for supporting KTX v2 textures |
